papers.title: A bipartite quantum-acoustic architecture stabilizes multi-exciton solitons at 323 K
papers.zh: 提出双组分量子-声学稳定架构，在 323 K 将三激子 Davydov 孤子相干半衰期由 6.5 fs 延至 42.6 fs。

papers.title: Generative Inverse Design of Shell Metamaterials through Continuous-Latent Conditional Flow Matching
papers.zh: 用连续潜空间条件流匹配生成式逆向设计力学壳体超材料单胞，匹配目标压缩应力-应变曲线。

papers.title: Size and temperature effect on Young's modulus of silicon nanowires
papers.zh: TEM 内 MEMS 拉伸测量 78 根硅纳米线杨氏模量，发现其随直径减小及温度升高（至 600 K）而降低。

papers.title: Study of jump-like superfast domain kinetics in lithium niobate crystals by in situ in-bulk imaging in slanted-cut plate
papers.zh: 在斜切 36° Y 切铌酸锂中原位体内光学成像，揭示畴合并后跳跃式超快畴动力学的分步机制。

papers.title: CO2 laser fabrication of PMMA-based multilayer 3D microchannel networks for tubular organ-on-chip models
papers.zh: 用商用 CO2 激光烧蚀快速制造 PMMA 多层三维微通道器官芯片，孔深宽比约 50:1。

papers.title: Atomic-scale defect-mediated electronic modulation in monolayer Cu2Pb on Cu(111)
papers.zh: 用低温STM/STS结合第一性原理研究Cu(111)上单层Cu2Pb表面合金的本征缺陷及其电子调制。

papers.title: Critical behavior, variable range hopping, and probable topological Hall effect in VCr2Te4 single crystal
papers.zh: 制备 VCr2Te4 单晶，研究其 74 K 亚铁磁转变临界行为、变程跳跃输运及可能的拓扑霍尔效应。

papers.title: All-optical 2D perovskite photodetector arrays for pixelated long-wave infrared imaging
papers.zh: 利用2D金属卤化物钙钛矿反射率温度系数，实现无读出电路的全光像素化LWIR成像探测阵列。

papers.title: Influence of dielectric environment on the optical properties of the CVD-grown monolayer WSe2
papers.zh: 用变温Raman与PL研究介电环境对CVD单层WSe2激子与trion发射的影响，低温和高介电环境促进trion形成。

papers.title: Arbitrary-Scale Light Field Super-Resolution via Spatio-Angular Consistent Neural Epipolar Geometry Learning
papers.zh: 提出空间-角度一致的神经极平面几何学习框架，实现任意尺度光场空间与角度联合超分辨。

papers.title: Characterizing the Spatiotemporal Boundaries of Functional Ultrasound for Brain Decoding
papers.zh: 以清醒小鼠胡须刺激表征功能超声成像（fUS-CBV）用于脑解码的时空边界。

papers.title: High-Contrast Broadband Optical Edge Detection by Low-Loss Geometric Phase Gratings
papers.zh: 超快激光在石英玻璃中写入纳米孔几何相位光栅，实现宽带高对比光学边缘检测，515 nm对比度达0.97。

papers.title: Destruction of Anderson localization by Kerr nonlinearity in non-Hermitian disordered lattices
papers.zh: 研究非厄米无序晶格中 Kerr 非线性如何破坏 Anderson 局域化。

papers.title: PIN‐PMN‐PT Surface Planar Waveguides Realized via He + Implantation
papers.zh: 采用He+离子注入在PIN-PMN-PT弛豫铁电单晶表层制备平面光波导，面向高性能电光调制器。

papers.title: Experimental demonstration of phase-conjugated twin-wave coherent reception over 100 km with injection locking assisted phase stabilization
papers.zh: 注入锁定稳定相位，使相位共轭孪生波完成100 km、200 MBaud的相干接收。

papers.title: Propagation invariant one-dimensional flat-top vector beam with conserved topology
papers.zh: 叠加正交偏振花瓣与高斯模式，生成强度和拓扑随传播保持不变的一维平顶矢量光束。

papers.title: Spin-induced lateral acoustic forces on chiral and achiral particles
papers.zh: 实验验证声学自旋选择性激发导波，并对手性及非手性颗粒产生侧向力。

papers.title: Membrane‐Targeted Nanoparticles for Neuronal Photomodulation
papers.zh: 以生物正交化学将金双锥等离激元纳米粒子靶向神经元膜，NIR光热实现神经活动抑制。

papers.title: Self-driven beta-radiation detection through a graphene/water/silicon heterostructure
papers.zh: 石墨烯/水/硅异质结构在β辐照下产生可逆电流瞬变，实现自驱动辐射检测。

papers.title: Learned optical compression for single-pixel quantitative phase imaging
papers.zh: 联合优化衍射编码与神经解码，实现单像素定量相位成像；测量数仅为重建像素数的2.55%。

papers.title: Structural and Optical Properties of PVP-Modified ZnS Nanoparticles for Photocatalytic Dye Degradation
papers.zh: PVP改性使ZnS估算带隙由3.69降至3.58 eV，并改变Raman与发光响应。

papers.title: PETE: A Hybrid Photonic and Electronic Thermoelectric Device for Direct Heat-to-Electricity Conversion
papers.zh: 提出用热电腿支撑近场间隙的混合热机，同时利用光子隧穿与热传导发电。

papers.title: MRSA‐Triggered Disassembly of an Immune‐Recruiting NIR Probe for Bacterial Imaging and Clearance
papers.zh: 设计MRSA触发解组装的免疫招募NIR半花菁探针，实现细菌激活成像与清除。

papers.title: Self‐Powered Ultrafast Solar‐Blind UV Photodetectors Enabled by CdO/SnO 2 Quantum‐Dot Heterojunction Networks
papers.zh: 构建亚5 nm CdO/SnO2量子点异质结网络，实现自供电、纳秒级响应的日盲紫外光电探测。

papers.title: Task-driven sparse-view planar X-ray computed tomography for axial metrology
papers.zh: 以物理灵敏度模型从稀疏X射线投影直接估计PCB轴向间隙，避免完整三维重建。

papers.title: Asymptotic r 2 Enhancement in Formulation‐Optimized Lipid‐Iron Oxide Nanoparticles for Assessing Glioblastoma Heterogeneity at Ultrahigh‐Field MRI
papers.zh: 通过配方调控脂质包覆SPION的r2弛豫率（9.4 T下13–418 mM⁻¹s⁻¹），用于胶质瘤超高场MRI评估。

papers.title: Superradiance fingerprints of moiré exciton-biexciton condensates: path-entangled biphoton vs. supercurrent-enabled one-photon channel
papers.zh: 理论研究扭转MoTe₂中激子—双激子凝聚态的超辐射及路径纠缠双光子通道。

papers.title: Boson sampling is fragile to loss
papers.zh: 证明系统扩展时，固定非零均匀损耗可使平均情形的玻色采样高效经典模拟。

papers.title: Plasmon modes in three-dimensional multifold semimetals. II. Rarita-Schwinger-Weyl and Kramers-Weyl nodes
papers.zh: 以RPA分析多重简并半金属的介电响应、等离激元及Landau阻尼。

papers.title: Exponential suppression of bit-flip errors in dissipative cat qubits
papers.zh: 证明大猫态幅度与弱单光子损耗下，耗散猫量子比特的比特翻转衰减率按幅度平方指数受抑。

papers.title: Unveiling Graphitic Carbon Nitride in Hexagonal Boron Nitride Epitaxy on Sapphire
papers.zh: 揭示MOVPE中意外生成的g-C3N4在蓝宝石上传递晶格取向，主导hBN外延对准。

papers.title: Self‐Assembled hBN Wrinkles as Planar Optofluidic Channels
papers.zh: 利用热致褶皱使剥离hBN自组装成无光刻的平面一维纳流控通道网络，可光学观测受限输运。

papers.title: Bioinspired Honeycomb‐Armored Photothermal Superhydrophobic Surface With Robust Mechanical Durability for Efficient Anti‐/De‐Icing
papers.zh: 激光刻蚀蜂窝微阵列并喷涂SiO2/碳纳米管，制备机械耐久的无氟光热超疏水防除冰表面。

papers.title: One‐Step Synthesis of Supramolecular Nanoparticles With Interlocking‐Enhanced Two‐Photon Fluorescence
papers.zh: 一步超分子组装制备PMBT纳米粒子，借互锁结构增强双光子荧光且无需扩展π共轭。

papers.title: Beyond Micro‐/Nanostructures: Close‐Packed Nanostructure Enables Superior Superhydrophobic Anti‐Icing Coatings
papers.zh: 对比同化学组成涂层，发现密堆纳米结构的超疏水防冰性能优于分级微纳结构。

papers.title: Cooling-path-selected self-assembly of telecom InAsP quantum dots
papers.zh: 通过冷却路径控制InP上InAsP量子点的自组装形貌，面向通信波段量子光源。

papers.title: Relaxation characteristics and spectral compression in the system of coupled radiating oscillators
papers.zh: 耦合模分析显示，两辐射振子可借助干涉将超短脉冲能量转为准单色辐射。

papers.title: All-to-All Connectivity in Superconducting Qubits via Metamaterial-Mediated Interactions
papers.zh: 编码transmon并借助超材料波导实现全连接，抑制共享模式诱发的旁观者纠缠。

papers.title: Optical Magnetic-Field Gating of Photon Avalanching Quantum Processes
papers.zh: 报告镧系掺杂纳米颗粒中光子雪崩阈值和非线性的光学磁场门控。

papers.title: Nonlinear Dynamics in Periodically Distributed Fibre Amplification Systems
papers.zh: 推导纵向非线性系数变化时周期分布式光纤放大系统的解析动力学。

papers.title: Optimal Fan-Out and Break-Even Routing Loss in Waveguide-Integrated Ge-on-Si SPAD Arrays
papers.zh: 以信息率权衡死时间和暗计数，优化波导集成Ge-on-Si SPAD阵列的分光与路由。

papers.title: Photon-pairing-enhanced distributed spectroscopy sensing over 400 km optical fiber
papers.zh: 利用光子配对增强技术，实现400 km光纤上的分布式光谱传感。
